notes.title: v1.4 Update
notes.content:
We’re excited to introduce three new generative AI modes that significantly enhance image stability, along with powerful image coherence tools for improved inter-frame consistency. Additionally, we’ve moved the Nodes tab to the right toolbar for easier access, alongside many other improvements. We also squashed a ton of bugs too!

In this update, we’re also deprecating the MX Fusion DLC and integrating those files directly into the main application. This change simplifies the installation process dramatically.

Please note: Starting January 1, 2025, the retail price of MXR will increase.

Our team has worked tirelessly on this update, and we can’t wait to see the amazing creations you bring to life with MXR!

- Team MXR

notes.title: MXR v1.2.3 Update!
notes.content: MXR 1.2.3 is here! MXR now supports multiple OSC and DMX inputs and many bug fixes and quality of life improvements.

notes.title: MXR v1.2.2 Update
notes.content: In the update we added two big new features: OSC support to the Nodes tab. You can now select OSC as an input mode. We also added experimental support for Stream Diffusion. Use objects and animations from the main MXR viewport to generate real-time genAI visuals via the Stream Diffusion DLC.
